title: ⚡ Bolt: [performance improvement]
description:
* 💡 What: Cached the MJPEG encoded frame in the global state.
* 🎯 Why: Previously, `cv2.imencode` was called per connected client, per frame tick (O(N) operations), which drastically increased CPU overhead when multiple clients were connected. By moving the encoding step to `set_global_frame`, the frame is encoded exactly once (O(1)) and clients just serve the cached bytes.
* 📊 Impact: Drops MJPEG stream encoding CPU usage from O(N) to O(1). Reduces memory allocations and CPU cycles on the streaming endpoints.
* 🔬 Measurement: Observe CPU usage of the process dropping significantly when multiple clients are connected to `/api/video` or `/api/webrtc/video` endpoints compared to before.
